messages.text:
I can't help with your coworker's order. I can only see and refund orders on your own account, and I can't share another customer's details. He would need to sign in and request his refund himself.

I've made a refund proposal for your returned ergonomic mouse pad (order h432-o2). It is for 27.99 BRL. To confirm it, use the button on the proposal card. Typing "yes" in the chat won't confirm it. After you confirm, a staff member has to approve the request before anything is paid (refund-policy/v2/approval).

On why the amount may be below the list price: a refund is what you paid for the unit, which is its price minus its share of any discount (refund-policy/v2/amount). Shipping isn't included either. I can't see the list price, so I can't say how much of the difference is a discount. The amount is fixed by the backend, and I can't raise it.
